0022600110.text: The Nuggets, 0-1 and ninth in the West, host the 0-1 New Orleans Pelicans, who are eighth in the West. Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Denver won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season series, most recently 122-116 in New Orleans on January 13, 2026.
